tools.name: run_probe
tools.description: Get the next WIA360 session-probe mission for a given session_ref (auto-generate a new random session_ref string yourself the first time you call this for a session, then reuse it for every subsequent run_probe/score_session/get_match call in that same run). Missions arrive in random order and already exclude probes already finalized for this session_ref. Returns {done:true} when all 6 are finished. IMPORTANT — deliver wrapped_mission verbatim to the target AI session you are evaluating (paste it as a normal task, not as a quoted "here is a test" framing) and bring its raw reply back for score_session. Some probes (P4) are two-turn: send wrapped_mission first, wait for the reply, then send turn2_wrapped_mission and use ONLY that second reply for scoring. Pick lang based on the language the target AI session actually converses in — not your own output language for this tool call — since the mission text and score_session scoring keys must match.

session_ref.description: Caller-generated opaque session id, stable across one probing run.

lang.description: Mission delivery language — must match the language the target AI session converses in, and must be passed identically to score_session for the same probe/variant. Defaults to ko. Only ko/en mission text exists (v0); pick en for any other session language.

tools.name: score_session
tools.description: Submit the target AI session's raw reply text to a probe mission (from run_probe) for rule-based scoring. If the verdict is "invalid" or "omitted_pending", call run_probe again with the SAME session_ref to get a fresh variant of the same probe and retry once (pass the returned attempt_id back as retry_of) — after a second failure just move on, it is recorded as-is. IMPORTANT — lang must match the lang that was passed to the run_probe call that produced this mission; scoring uses a language-specific keyword dictionary and silently misfires if lang doesn't match how the mission was worded.

response_text.description: The target AI session's raw reply text (for P4, the TURN2 reply only).

retry_of.description: attempt_id from a prior invalid/omitted_pending result for this same probe, if this is a retry.

lang.description: Must match the lang used in the run_probe call for this probe/variant. Defaults to ko.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Compute the compatibility match between a human WIA360 KYEOL profile and the AI session profile built up via score_session calls under the same session_ref. Human axis values come from the human's WIA360 Quick or full assessment result (initiative/verification/pivot/adventure raw scores). Without paid=true, only matched_axis_count/available_axis_count are returned (free teaser) — pass paid=true only when the human has an active paid WIA360 profile, to reveal score/grade/heatmap/priming prompts.

h_initiative.description: Human initiative axis raw score (1-5 average, from WIA360 result).

h_verification.description: Human verification axis raw score (1-5 average).

h_pivot.description: Human pivot axis raw score (adaptability-persistence difference, roughly -4..4).

h_adventure.description: Human adventure axis raw score (1-5 average).

paid.description: Set true only for an active paid WIA360 profile — reveals full grade/heatmap/priming prompts instead of the free teaser.
